name: umm-maybe ConvNeXt AI-image detector (HF)
reason: Measured locally (2026-09-21) and rejected: the checkpoint does not separate the corpus under either label reading — with id2label {0:artificial,1:human}, P(artificial) is 0.01-0.26 across DALL-E fakes AND real photos (reads everything as human); read the other way it flags everything. Either the published head drifted from the card or the labels are effectively swapped; no wiring survives the measured gate.
fetch: HF hub model umm-maybe/AI-image-detector (~350 MB) — kept unwired.
limitations: This profile never produces scores; it exists to document the measured rejection.
Note: score_label paths must pair with score_activation 'none' — the returned value is already a softmax probability (a default sigmoid re-application pushed a 3% probability to 51).
